body_markdown:
### Slim, Sculptural, and Powerful: Moen Debuts the Kivo™ Modern Kitchen Faucet Collection


This striking new line of Moen faucets redefines modern kitchen design with its ultra-thin, tubular silhouette—Moen’s thinnest faucet architecture yet.


Designed for kitchens where every detail matters, the[Moen Kivo™ Pulldown](https://shop.moen.com/search?q=Kivo) leads with an ultra-thin tubular silhouette — Moen’s thinnest faucet architecture yet – and a profile that brings genuine minimalism to the kitchen without the usual tradeoffs. Behind that slim form is Power Clean™ spray technology, a Reflex™ retractable hose system, and Duralock™ Quick Connect System for tool-free, click-secure faucet hose installation.


Available in multiple finishes, this faucet is designed to move seamlessly between modern and transitional kitchens.
